formTitle: Consolidated General Application Form for Non-Immigrant Visa, Special Work Permit and Provisional Work Permit [Except Student Visa and SSP]
checkoutEligibleNote: Not yet decided -- same open business-classification question as the other mapped forms. This mapping covers field-level automation only; checkout eligibility is a separate business decision.
reproductionRightsNote: Confirmed directly on the form itself: 'This document may be reproduced and is NOT FOR SALE', printed at the top of both pages.
derivedFrom: Measured from 300 DPI rasters of both pages of the real original PDF (downloaded from the private fis-bi-forms-library R2 bucket, originals/CGAF-002-Rev3.pdf -- 188,579 bytes, Foxit PhantomPDF Printer-produced, 2015). Same comb-grid-per-field template family as BOC04.QF.001/BOC04.QF.002, independently re-confirmed to share the same ~12.96pt uniform cell pitch despite the different PDF-generation toolchain. This is a DISTINCT form from BOC04.QF.002 (same general subject area -- non-immigrant visa / special work permit / provisional work permit -- but genuinely different field structure in several places: a 4-option, not 5-option, 'Number of Months/Years Applied For' checkbox group; a single 'Name of Institution' field on page 2 instead of separate Spouse Name/Company Name fields; TWO Character Reference slots instead of one). Every coordinate here was measured directly and independently from THIS form's own original PDF -- none were copied from BOC04.QF.002's own coordinate-map.json.

measurementNotes.distinctFromBOC04QF002: CGAF-002-Rev3 and BOC04.QF.002 cover overlapping visa categories and share the same template family's visual style, but are NOT the same form and are never substituted for one another anywhere in this mapping, the engine, or the Worker's catalogue/registry. Each has its own preserved original PDF, its own independently-measured coordinate-map.json, and its own questionnaire.json. This config makes no claim about which of the two (if either) is the current BI-prescribed version for any given applicant's situation -- that is an operational/legal determination outside the scope of an engine mapping, not something inferred from a document-control footer or file metadata.
measurementNotes.uniformCellPitchReconfirmed: The ~12.96pt cell pitch already established on BOC04.QF.001 (a native Word/Microsoft 365 PDF export) was independently re-measured and reconfirmed on this form despite it being produced by a different toolchain (Foxit PhantomPDF Printer, 2015) -- both apparently derive from the same underlying Word table-column convention.
measurementNotes.rightColumnDateFieldsCorrectedAfterVisua: Date of Latest Arrival and Last Day of Authorized Stay (Section II, right-hand column) were initially measured with their MMM/YYYY sub-boxes shifted one cell too far right -- the year box was recorded as only 3 cells, and a measurementNotes entry incorrectly described this as a genuine original-form inconsistency rather than a measurement error. A pixel-ruled visual-grid-overlay crop (the authoritative tie-breaker this project uses whenever a numeric scan is ambiguous) caught it directly: the real original has Day(2 cells, 347.04-372.96) / gap / Month(3 cells, 385.56-424.44) / gap / Year(4 cells, 437.4-489.24) -- the same 2+3+4 pattern as every other date field on this form, including the left-column Expiry Date/Valid Until. Corrected; both right-column date fields' Month and Year colsPt now match the real measured boundaries.
measurementNotes.landlineMobileIndependentBoxes: Confirmed by direct visual inspection: every Landline/Mobile pair on this form (Section III personal contact, both Character Reference blocks, Petitioner's registered-address contact) is two fully independent boxes with their own top and bottom borders, not a shared-border pair.
measurementNotes.nameOfInstitutionIsTwoLines: Unlike most single-line name fields on this form, 'Name of Institution' (Section IV, page 2) is genuinely two stacked comb rows of 41 cells each, confirmed visually -- mapped as institutionNameLine1/institutionNameLine2.
measurementNotes.claimStubAndRepresentativeBlockNotPopula: The 'APPLICANT'S ACR I-CARD CLAIM STUB' (bottom of page 1) and the back-page Representative/Accredited Travel Agency claim block (bottom of page 2) are both BI-counter-completed sections, not part of the online application -- neither is mapped as a fillable field, consistent with the same treatment already established for BOC04.QF.001.
measurementNotes.natureOfInstitutionOthersSpecify: The 'Others [Please specify] ____' blank after the Nature of Institution checkboxes is a genuine free-text line (confirmed visually -- not a comb grid), mapped as a freeTextField (natureOthersSpecify) rather than left unmapped, since an applicant choosing 'Others' needs somewhere to specify it.
